text: Stop. HSBC just named five sectors for your twenty twenty seven watchlist.
In the last month, the Nifty jumped twelve percent, to twenty five thousand and forty four.
And Citi now sees the Nifty at twenty eight thousand, by the end of twenty twenty seven.
But a target means nothing without the right sectors.
Sector one. Banks. HSBC points to strong credit growth.
Sector two. Industrials. Capital goods, cement, ports, and electronics manufacturing.
Sector three. Consumer discretionary. Retailers and autos.
And one they like less. Consumer staples, compared with retailers and autos.
Remember, this is a watchlist, not a buy list. Brokerage views can be wrong.
Follow for your twenty twenty seven money plan. And stop, check these five sectors first.
